note: 22 Sept 2026 - 'The 7 WORDS Millionaires Used To Get Rich' (Rumble v7dqhzo, 2160p). The ladder: wish, want, could, can, will, in the process, I am. Opener and the affirmations clip carry the WISH offer.

clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says the wealthy people he knows use seven words, out loud, in private, in a specific order.

It works like a ladder. Each rung moves you from wishing for something to knowing it's yours, and you don't skip steps.

Your income is about what it was five years ago because you are the same person, saying the same things.

#kevintrudeau #manifesting #selftalk #wealthmindset #yourwishisyourcommand #success

You don't start with "I want to be a millionaire."

Kevin Trudeau says start one rung lower: "I wish." Anyone can make a wish, so nothing inside you argues with it. Say it out loud for a day or two and the needle starts moving.

Only then do you move up to "I want" - and that one does fight back, because of everything you were taught about money.

Say the wish first. Earn the want.

#kevintrudeau #manifesting #affirmations #moneymindset #selftalk #success

"I could become a millionaire." You're not promising anything. You're only admitting it's possible.

Kevin Trudeau says say it ten or twenty times out loud until it feels true, then move up to "I can."

That's when your mind starts arguing: not smart enough, wrong family, too much debt. Let it. Each time you say it, some of that charge burns off and the old story loses its grip.

The past does not equal the future.

#kevintrudeau #selfimage #mindset #affirmations #manifesting #success

"I will be a millionaire." Not today. Someday.

Kevin Trudeau says that's exactly why this rung is easy to accept: there's no deadline to argue with.

It still stirs up what you were told. A teacher who said you'd never amount to anything. A parent who said you'd be broke your whole life. Let those surface, because that is how they lose their power.

Say it daily and the picture you hold of yourself quietly changes.

#kevintrudeau #mindset #selfimage #manifesting #selftalk #success

"I will" is someday. "I am in the process of becoming a millionaire" is today.

Kevin Trudeau says that one sentence only holds up if you're actually doing something: the books, the courses, the training, the work.

So it does two things at once. It tells the truth about today, and it pushes you to act so it stays true.

What would make that sentence true for you this week?

#kevintrudeau #action #manifesting #habits #success #wealthmindset

Every book on affirmations tells you to start with "I am a millionaire." Kevin Trudeau says that's exactly wrong.

You don't start there. You end there.

You say it when you can see it, the way a player who's past the last defender knows the ball is in before he scores. Not belief - belief still carries doubt. Knowing.

Say it too early and it just argues with who you think you are.

#kevintrudeau #affirmations #manifesting #selfimage #yourwishisyourcommand #success

"I already know that."

Kevin Trudeau's answer: to know and not to do is not to know.

Knowledge is only power once it's used. He just handed you the method. It changes nothing until you say the words out loud.

#kevintrudeau #takeaction #knowledge #discipline #success #mindset
